_comment: Scout golden set (hand-labelled ground truth) for api/scripts/score_scout.py and api/eval.py. The notices are the SYNTHETIC seed notices in data/seed_tenders/ (fictional). Scored fields: deadline (BS ISO date, and AD datetime in NPT to the minute), estimated_cost_npr (integer NPR, null = the notice has no unambiguous cost), required_doc_types (set of schemas.enums.DocType). Extra fields: language (notice language), relevant (is the tender worth pursuing for the demo company; same as data/golden/match_relevance.json). Mandatory-requirement labels live in compliance_requirements.json. Entries with 'confirm' in notes were decided by the labeller from the labelling rules and await owner confirmation.

labelling_rules.deadline: The bid SUBMISSION deadline, not publication, document purchase or opening. A corrigendum's new deadline. A date-only deadline is 23:59:59 NPT. null if the notice gives no computable date.
labelling_rules.estimated_cost_npr: The cost estimate as the notice states it. null when it is absent or ambiguous (e.g. an 'in thousands' table cell that contradicts the words, or digits that contradict the amount in words).
labelling_rules.required_doc_types: Documents the bidder must submit or must hold (a licence the bidder 'must have' counts), including conditional ones (JV agreement if the notice demands it from JV bidders). Bid security counts when the notice demands one. 'tax clearance or tax return' is tax_clearance only (the Rule 40(2)(d) alternative). Evidence implied only by a criterion (turnover, experience) is NOT listed unless the notice names the document. Any non-standard document (payment voucher, ISO certificate, vehicle bluebook) is 'other'. Order does not matter.
labelling_rules.tax_clearance_fy: Informational, not scored yet: the fiscal year the tax clearance must cover.

tenders.notes: Mixed EN/NE. BS and AD in one string. 'other' = the bid-document fee payment voucher. Licence must be renewed for F/Y 2083/84.
English. Cost in crore. '12:00 noon'. Liquid assets / turnover / experience are criteria, not named documents.
ICB goods, AD-only deadline (BS is the lookup-table conversion). 'other' = manufacturer's authorization and ISO 13485 / CE / FDA certificates.

All-Nepali sealed quotation. Deadline is 'within 15 days of publication' with no publication date: null (never guess). Bid security is a percentage (धरौटी 2.5%), still a demanded document. confirm: business_licence comes from the intro ('licensed contractors').
Nepali with an English line. Cost is a table cell 'रु. हजारमा' (4,850 thousand) while the prose says 'about fifty lakh': ambiguous, so null. Licence: 'घ' class or above must be held.

PDF copy-paste artefacts (hyphenated words, repeated header, broken table). Cost '68.5 lakh' in a table row. BS date 2083/08/03 with '(19th Nov 2026)'. 'JV agreement must be notarised' counts as jv_agreement.
Corrigendum: old deadline 2083/07/10, NEW 2083/07/25 (the label). No cost, no documents. confirm: the 'bid security validity extended proportionally' line is NOT counted as a demanded bid_security.
Deadline already passed at the golden clock. Licence class D renewed for F/Y 2083/84.
AD-only deadline ('12:00 noon on 30 November 2026'). 'other' = Social Security Fund registration. Tax clearance for 'the latest fiscal year': no FY stated.
All-Nepali sealed quotation, Devanagari digits and danda separators. 'other' = vehicle bluebook, insurance and fitness test copies. Bid security = धरौटी voucher or bank guarantee.
All-Nepali NCB with Devanagari numerals, sub-items (क)-(ङ). Licence 'घ' or above renewed for F/Y 2083/84.

ICB, AD-only deadline, cost 'NPR 2,400 million', bid security 'NPR 48,000,000' (western grouping). confirm: business_licence from 'domestic bidders must hold a Class A licence'; jv_agreement not labelled (JV only permitted).
Sealed quotation, BS + AD, '12:00 noon'. Bid security is 2.5% of the quoted amount (percent only).
Two deadlines: form purchase 2083/07/27 (NOT the label) and submission 2083/07/28 12:00. Cost is the compound 'रु. ३२ लाख ५० हजार' (= 3,250,000).
'Rs. 1,50,000,00 (Rupees Fifteen Lakh only)' is mis-grouped and contradicts the words: null. Date is DD/MM/YYYY in BS with no B.S. label. 'Bid bond' = bid_security.
